Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String, ByVal out As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sh As Object, s As String, v As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\a.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 1
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\b.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 2
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\a.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, -1, -1)
    Case 3
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\b.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, -1, -1)
    Case 4
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\c.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, -1, -1)
    Case 5
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\d.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, -1, -1)
    Case 6
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\b.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 50, -1)
    Case 7
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\b.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, -1, 50)
    Case 8
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\b.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 0, 0)
    Case 9
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\missing.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 10
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\a.png", msoFalse, msoFalse, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 11
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\a.png", msoTrue, msoFalse, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 12
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\a.png", msoTrue, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 13
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\a.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\a.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 14
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\a.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\b.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 15
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\a.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.Delete: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 1, 1, 9, 9)
    Case 16
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\a.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.Name = "Mine": sh.Left = 30: sh.Width = 60
    Case 17
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\a.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.Line.Visible = msoTrue
    Case 18
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\a.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.Line.Weight = 3
    Case 19
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\a.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255
    Case 20
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\a.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
    Case 21
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\a.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): Set sh = sh.Duplicate
    Case 22
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture2(folder & "\a.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40, 1)
    Case 23
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture2(folder & "\a.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40, 3)
    End Select
    s = "ok"
Measured:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(sh)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Type
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.AutoShapeType
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Left
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Top
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Width
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Height
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.LockAspectRatio
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.ID
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.Visible
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Line.Visible
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Line.Weight
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(sh.PictureFormat)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.PictureFormat.Brightness
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.PictureFormat.Contrast
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.PictureFormat.Crop.ShapeWidth
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.PictureFormat.CropLeft
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Placement
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Shapes.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    wb.SaveAs out & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Measured
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal out As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 23
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder, out)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
